title: rcf define readiness: a frozen tree with nothing pending reads ready, and the tree line reports a fully built queue
summary: On a frozen tree whose delta is empty, D1 brief:sinceFreeze is not applicable (ok, total 0), so D1 and D8 pass on their other checks and readiness reads ready; the shared Ready-to-build verdict line names the freeze and says nothing is pending (and that every FBS is built when every FBS is complete or verified), and the tree line reads 'Built N of N' when every FBS is built. A non-empty delta on a frozen tree still asks for a brief statement since the freeze; the unfrozen tree is unchanged.
approach: src/query/delta.js: a pure isEmptyDelta(delta) helper, true only on a frozen delta with no changed, added or removed id. src/query/gates.js checkD1Brief: when the freeze record is present and isEmptyDelta holds, brief:sinceFreeze is makeCheck('brief:sinceFreeze', 'delta', 0, []); every other D1 check and every other stage is untouched, so D8 freeze:priorGates passes when D1 does. src/query/readiness.js: computeReadiness adds tree.fbsBuilt (the complete plus verified count from computeQueue totals) and tree.nothingPending (isEmptyDelta of the delta); formatVerdictLines prints 'Ready-to-build: yes. Frozen at <short hash>; nothing pending.' when readyToBuild.ok and nothing is pending, with ' and every FBS built' before the full stop when fbsBuilt equals fbsTotal and fbsTotal is above 0, and keeps 'Freezeable at <hash>' everywhere else; formatTreeLine prints 'Built <n> of <n>' in place of 'Build at (none) of <n>' when every FBS is built. The viewer's Readiness tab already renders both strings through formatVerdictLines and formatTreeLine, so no viewer change is needed.
deliverables: src/query/delta.js isEmptyDelta, src/query/gates.js checkD1Brief and src/query/readiness.js computeReadiness, formatVerdictLines and formatTreeLine (builder)
